name: amk
description: A curated knowledge base of Markdown atoms with gap tracking: answers cite atom ids, and questions the knowledge base cannot answer become recorded gaps. Complements Claude Code memory (CLAUDE.md, auto memory); does not replace it. Read-only unless you enable writes. Needs Node >= 22.18.

config.title: Memory config
config.description: Path to memory.config.json, relative to the project root. Its root and gapLedger fields may be absolute, to use a memory outside the project.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Off: the server refuses memory_apply, memory_gap_close, and memory_close_gaps with autoApply; memory_gap_add still records gaps in the ledger. On: atoms can be written and gaps closed.
